title: SEO Associate
description:
**Who are we?**

Cracku was launched in July 2014 by a group of three IIT\-IIM alumni who are using technology to improve the learning experience of students preparing for competitive examinations. We have grown very fast and have helped thousands of students crack exams. As a startup, we have a very relaxed culture and expect our team members to be driven and self\-motivated.

**Responsibilities**

* **Keyword Research:** Conduct thorough keyword research to identify high\-value, relevant keywords for targeted campaigns and content optimization.
* **SEO Audits:** Perform comprehensive SEO audits to assess website health, identify technical issues, and recommend solutions for optimization.
* **On\-Page SEO:** Optimize on\-page SEO to improve keyword relevance and make content suitable for AI Overviews.
* **Web Analytics Analysis:** Utilize web analytics tools such as Google Analytics and Search Console to track website performance, monitor key metrics, and evaluate the effectiveness of SEO efforts.
* **Communication and Collaboration:** Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including marketing, content, and development, to align SEO strategies with broader business objectives.

**Qualifications**

* Expertise in Keyword Research and SEO audits.
* Knowledge of AEO and GEO for improving content visibility in AI\-based search engines.
* Experience Using Web Analytics Tools: Familiarity with web analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Google Search Console, or similar tools
* Strong Communication Skills and Team Collaboration

**Preferred Qualification:**

* 0–1 years of proven experience in SEO.

**Why should you join us?**

Cracku is a pretty cool place to work at and your colleagues will be very smart and focused people. You will be reporting to and working closely with IIM alumni.

**Salary**: 25K\-30K per month

**Location:** Hyderabad (On\-site)

**Basic Qualification:** Graduate

**No. of openings:** 2

Job Type: Full\-time

Pay: ₹25,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Food provided
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person
